The Lean route instead bounds s and-then t between the infimum of s and t in SPred X (208IX) and its own ceiling, using the absorption rule 213V twice. Different route, same conclusion.

226IV.1 (eff.tex:7466, Definition): n <= m for kernels when n factors through m. The Lean def is stated for arbitrary parallel-target maps, not only kernels, which is a widening; it is used only at kernels. The equivalence relation and the poset Nsb A are not formalized (deliberate, per the file header: SPred stands in for Nsb, following 227III). Definition, no proof.

226IV.2 (eff.tex:7466, Definition): f is exact when the unique g with f = ker(cok f) after g after cok(ker f) is an iso. The Lean existentially quantifies the chosen kernels and cokernels rather than speaking of "the" ones; equivalent, since kernels and cokernels are unique up to iso (isKernel_unique, isCokernel_unique in the same file) and being an iso is invariant. The thesis's uniqueness of g is not asserted, only existence of an iso g with the factorization, which is what "exact" amounts to. Definition, no proof.

226V.1 (eff.tex:7506, Theorem): a map is a kernel iff it is a comprehension. Hypothesis DaggerPrimeEffectus for the thesis's dagger-effectus (equivalent by 215III). Proof follows the thesis's citation of effectus-kernels (200III).
226V.2: a map is a cokernel iff it is a quotient for a sharp predicate. Proof follows the thesis's citation of effectus-cokernels (205II).

226V.3: a map is exact iff it is pristine. eff.tex discharges this with "Unfolding definitions, it is easy to see"; the Lean supplies both directions in full, using 226V.1/.2 and the standard form of a pristine map (218VI). Same route, filled in.

226V (eff.tex:7506, Theorem): a dagger-effectus is a pointed homological category. The Lean renders the three homological-category axioms of 226IV (kernels closed under composition, cokernels closed under composition, and the homology axiom for a kernel m and a cokernel q with ker q <= m). The "pointed semiexact" half (zero object, all kernels and cokernels) is not restated here; the doc points at 200III and 205II for it. The homology-axiom proof follows eff.tex:7536 through homology_lemma and compr-is-full.

227II.1 (eff.tex:7569, Definition): the pair f then g is exact at the middle object when ker(cok f) is equivalent to ker g. The Lean def spells the equivalence out as KernelLE in both directions over existentially chosen cokernel and kernels. The long-exact-sequence notion of the same point is not defined separately; the Snake Lemma spells it out as a conjunction. Definition, no proof.

227III.1 (eff.tex:7605, Example): the pair is exact at the middle object iff im perp f = ceil(1 after g). The printed form of this point says ceil(1 after f) and is false; berr.tex erratum eff-dagger-conc-ex corrects it to ceil(1 after g), and the Lean states the corrected form. Already in ERRATA.md. Example, no proof. Note in passing that 227III.4, which is not formalized, appears to have the same kind of slip: left-modularity is given as f box of f diamond of im k equals im k join ceil(1 after f), where 228II's condition 1 and Grandis' definition both need the orthocomplement ceil(1 after f) perp.

227V (diamondboxlemma, eff.tex:7636, Lemma), first half: pi box after pi diamond = id for any comprehension pi. Statement matches (stated pointwise at a sharp predicate s). The proof transcribes eff.tex:7642, using that the dagger of a comprehension is sharp.
227V, second half: zeta diamond after zeta box = id for any quotient zeta for a sharp predicate. Statement matches. Proof transcribes eff.tex:7650.

228II (eff.tex:7670, Snake Lemma). The hypotheses match the thesis's equivalent conditions 1 to 8 clause for clause: m1 to m4 are conditions 1 to 4 with the suprema and infima stated as SPred.IsSup and SPred.IsInf rather than as lattice operations, row1 and row2 are conditions 5 and 6 (exactness of the rows) via ExactAt, hg and hh are conditions 7 and 8. Both commuting squares are assumed. The conclusion is the existence of the connecting map from ker c to cok a making the six-term sequence exact at its four inner objects, with the chosen kernels and cokernels being the standard ones and f bar, g bar, h bar, k bar as in the thesis. The proof builds only the LEFT face of 228III's cube: the right face (v, h prime), snakehdiamondone and three of the four forms of snakedidents are never needed, because the four exactness statements only ever evaluate d diamond at 1 and d box at 0. ERRATA.md records this as informational, not a defect in the thesis.
